payload.text: East Oakland intake figures are verified in the INIT-007 placement report — first cohort is placed, numbers are real, and the D5 dispatch performance assessment is filed: we're seeing the gap, and we're closing it.

The schematics honor the merchant covenant we executed at C107 — the staging lot access, the panadería sightlines, the curb cuts Elena Soria Dominguez counted are all in the drawings. payload.text: The pre-audit operational benchmark framework and intake criteria for INIT-005 are formally submitted to guide the upcoming review and safeguard the remaining $16,961,538.45 balance.
Executing the committee vote on the $2.5M Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake ordinance (INIT-009) and ordering administrative service audits for Adams Point and Eastlake.

I cast my vote to advance the West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund (INIT-010) and I'm directing stabilization dollars to the Brooklyn corridor — municipal service plans due by week's end so we target relief where the decay is building.

The East Oakland co-response protocol alignment memo has been filed. It establishes clear transfer thresholds between OPD sector patrol and OARI dispatchers for behavioral health calls, including dispatch notification criteria, scene hand-off protocols, and escalation call-back windows for sworn units. The memo is on file with the Mayor's office and the OARI program office.
I will co-sponsor and docket the INIT-008 Downtown Economic Revitalization legislation and certify the Phase II site remediation schedule for the Baylight District (INIT-006) as requested.
